sample_method: 18 meeting IDs with smallest SHA-256 rank plus shortest and longest transcript; duplicate IDs removed

contract_checks: each returned product candidate has at least one source
returned product candidate scores are labeled heuristic

limitations: The same 1,126-meeting dataset was used in earlier project stages; this is not validation on new meetings.
No human labels are available; label counts and contract checks do not measure accuracy.
Only lexical fallback was run; optional model artifacts are absent from this checkout.
